Kokoro TTS

Kokoro is a compact open-weight text-to-speech model designed for local inference on modest hardware. It produces natural sounding speech without requiring a cloud service, which makes it suitable for privacy-preserving assistants that must run entirely on device.

The model is notable for its small parameter count relative to output quality. Running it locally avoids per-character billing and removes the network round trip from the response path, so spoken replies begin sooner.

Deployment typically pairs the model with a streaming audio pipeline so that the first chunk of audio can be played before the full utterance has been synthesised.
